text:
jasmin: Hey team -- opened a PR to update infra bootstrap scripts but GitHub won't let me merge: "You can’t merge this pull request because required reviewers haven’t approved: @infra/codeowners". I thought frontend-devs would cover this, do I need to be added to infra/codeowners?

owen: Welcome Jasmin! Codeowners is a separate nested team (org > infra > codeowners). Being in frontend-devs won't grant that approval permission. Who did you tag in the PR?

jasmin: I tagged @frontend-devs for review but the CODEOWNERS file requires @infra/codeowners for anything under /ops/ and the scripts are in ops/bootstrap. Didn’t realize it was a different team.

meera: @platform-bot can you check whether jasmin is a member of infra or the nested codeowners subteam? Also if we can temporarily add a maintainer to dismiss required review so CI can run.

platform-bot: Lookup: jasmin (gh: jasmin-w)  org membership: Member; teams: frontend-devs, docs-editors. Not in infra or infra/codeowners.

meera: Thanks. Jasmin, we have two options: (1) add you to infra/codeowners if you should regularly approve infra changes, or (2) request a review from an existing infra/codeowners member and they can approve/merge this PR. Which do you prefer? For now I can add one-off maintainer privilege on this PR so CI can finish if it's urgent.

jasmin: It's a one-off bootstrap tweak for my onboarding lab. Prefer not to be permanent member if not needed. Can someone approve this PR?

owen: I can review/approve. Quick note: for future ops changes the PR template suggests tagging @infra/codeowners; theres also a short onboarding note about which teams cover infra vs app code. Maybe that doc needs a clearer map.

meera: Approved and merged. Also filed ONB-333 to add a small matrix to the onboarding guide showing common CODEOWNERS mappings (apps vs infra vs docs) and which teams to ask for membership. Jasmin you should now see the merged commit in your branch.

onboard-bot: Logged onboarding suggestion ONB-333: add CODEOWNERS->team mapping to onboarding docs.

jasmin: Merge complete, CI green. Thanks everyone! Will follow up if I make more infra changes and will request membership if this becomes frequent.
